exF.q1: Who gets back in touch these days?
exF.q1a: Me, always. If I don't write, nothing happens.
exF.q1b: Me, nearly always. She replies, but she never starts.
exF.q1c: Both of us, about as often as each other.
exF.q1d: Her, often, and for no particular reason.
exF.q2a: Never. We haven't seen each other since the breakup.
exF.q2b: We have met up, but I'm the one who asked.
exF.q2c: She suggested it once, for a specific reason: belongings, a favour.
exF.q2d: She suggests seeing you with no pretext, just to see you.
exF.q3: Has she said anything clear about her feelings since the breakup?
exF.q3a: Yes: she told me it was over, and she has never gone back on it.
exF.q3b: No, nothing. The subject has never come up again.
exF.q3c: Hints, half-finished sentences, never anything clear.
exF.q3d: Yes: she told me she still thinks about me, or that she regrets it.
exF.q4: When she talks about the two of you, what tense does she use?
exF.q4a: She doesn't talk about it at all.
exF.q4b: The past, only. Memories, and nothing else.
exF.q4c: The present: what we've become, the way we speak to each other now.
exF.q4d: The future: things we could do again, a “maybe one day”.
exF.q5: What do you talk about when you do talk?
exF.q5b: Logistics: belongings, paperwork, the flat, the kids.
exF.q5c: Our lives, like two people who know each other well.
exF.q5d: Us: what happened, what we could have done differently.
exF.q6: What have her family and friends done since the breakup?
exF.q6a: They cut contact, like she did.
exF.q6b: They stay polite when we run into each other, nothing more.
exF.q6c: They keep in touch, but we never talk about her.
exF.q6d: They give me news of her, or tell me she still talks about me.
exF.q7: When you write to her, how does she reply?
exF.q7a: She doesn't reply, or she replies days later.
exF.q7b: A short, polite answer, and the conversation ends there.
exF.q7c: Within the day, and the conversation goes on for a while.
exF.q7d: Straight away, at any hour, and she's the one who keeps it going.
exF.q8: How does she react when she hears you're seeing someone?
exF.q8a: No reaction at all, or she's genuinely pleased for me.
exF.q8b: I have no idea, the subject has never come up.
exF.q8c: She asks questions: who it is, how long, whether it's serious.
exF.q8d: She turns cold or sarcastic, or she gets back in touch right afterwards.
exF.q9: Where do things stand with the belongings left at each other's place?
exF.q9a: Everything was returned within the week, she insisted on settling it fast.
exF.q9b: Everything was returned, with no particular urgency.
exF.q9c: There are still things on both sides, and neither of us mentions it.
exF.q9d: She draws it out: one item at a time, or she forgets to return the rest.
exF.q10: Where is she in her own life?
exF.q10a: She's in a relationship, and it looks serious.
exF.q10b: She's seeing people, going out, having fun.
exF.q10c: I have no idea, she shows nothing of her life.
exF.q10d: She's single, and she doesn't seem to be looking.
exF.q11: How long has her current behaviour been going on?
exF.q11a: The breakup is very recent, it's far too early to tell.
exF.q11b: A few weeks, with ups and downs.
exF.q11c: Several months, and it has stayed at the same rhythm.
exF.q11d: A long time, and she has never really disappeared from my life.
exF.q12a: She blocked my account, or she shut down her own.
exF.q12b: Nothing at all. She doesn't look, or I can't see it.
exF.q12d: She watches everything, reacts, likes what I post.
exF.q13: What happened to what was left of the two of you online?
exF.q13a: She deleted everything, and she did it fast.
exF.q13b: She cleaned up her social media, I don't know about the rest.
exF.q13c: The photos are still there, she hasn't touched them.
exF.q13d: She reposted one, or she sent me a photo of us.
exF.q14: What happens on birthdays and holidays?
exF.q14a: Nothing, not even for my birthday.
exF.q14b: A short message, the one she sends everybody.
exF.q14c: A personal message, one that shows she thought about it.
exF.q14d: She also marks the dates that belong to no one but the two of you.
exF.q15a: She did, explaining clearly why, and she stuck to it.
exF.q15b: She did, but without ever really explaining.
exF.q15c: I did, or we agreed on it together.
exF.q15d: Nobody really: it just stopped without anyone saying so.
